report.clinical_summary: Patient with Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) in early stages, currently on active surveillance with monthly blood draws. Experiencing daily severe headaches (7/10) and frequent night sweats that disrupt sleep. Headaches significantly impact daily functioning and concentration. Patient has not discussed these symptoms with their medical team yet. CLL described as stable and slow-progressing, with treatment potentially years away.
